evidence.description: Likely display message processor (85% confidence). Allocates 0x200-byte buffer, calls text/layout helpers, updates status flags. Invoked by multiple message handlers.
Likely flash writer (80% confidence). Only called when validator @ 0x002BFDDC returns non-zero. Needs guard condition verification.
Hypothesis (60% confidence). Literal @ 0x002113CC resolves to this Thumb address. Needs RAM dump for runtime behavior verification.

shared_notifier callgraph: 2 inbound callers (0x002c2098, 0x002c3554); allocates 0x200-byte stack buffer, copies strings, calls layout helpers (0x0022714c), image alloc (0x0020c798) and raster copy (0x0020ddbc) before returning; consistent with display/update notifier role.
evidence.result: analyze_function_complete(0x2302ec): 152 instr, 18 calls incl. layout/copy; inbound callers at 0x002c2628 and 0x002c3648

evidence.description: flash_writer @0x002BFC34 actually writes 24-bit color value into global struct (RGB565 packing) and returns previous value; 18 instr, no outbound calls, 40 inbound callsites incl. update_copy_or_flash.
evidence.result: analyze_function_complete(0x2bfc34): packs RGB (24-bit) into RGB565-like field at DAT_002bfc7c+0x14; returns old value; 40 inbound callers.

evidence.description: queue_controller @0x00244F8C (actually starts at 0x244cd4 per decomp) is a large queue/allocator managing messages; 635 instr, 40 outbound calls to alloc/copy/dispatch helpers (0x20c798, 0x20dcac, 0x3467c, 0x33178, etc.), consistent with upgrade/UI queue management.
evidence.result: analyze_function_complete(0x244f8c): ~635 instr, 40 outbound calls to alloc/parse/layout functions; manipulates queue structs, thresholds, and message buffers.

evidence.description: hw_display_update @0x00230E04 programs a register block (likely BLT/VPOST): waits on bit0 idle, sets bit11, writes color and stride/coords, sets start bit; inbound caller at 0x002590a8.
evidence.result: analyze_function_complete(0x230e04): waits for busy clear on *DAT_00230f34, sets bit 11, writes color (swizzled), sets stride/coords, kicks start bit; 76 instr, 1 inbound call.

evidence.description: hw_display_update MMIO base: DAT_00230f34 = 0xB100D000 (display/BLT base), confirming register writes target VPOST/BitBLT block.

queue_vtable_callback @0x00208592 (actually function at 0x002081b4) is a comparator/controller for queued items: heavy branching on state byte @+0x251, compares ranges at offsets 0x228/0x22c, calls compare helpers (0x07f5c, 0x08088, 0x09570) and queue ops (0x06490, 0x07c14).
evidence.result: analyze_function_complete(0x208592 -> function 0x002081b4): ~294 instr, 30 outbound calls to compare/queue helpers; compares entry coordinates/time ranges and state flags; consistent with vtable comparator for queue management.

evidence.description: queue comparator cases: state byte @+0x251 selects comparator—cases 0/1/2 use string compare (0x09570); cases 3/4 use region-A compare (0x07f5c on packed fields @0x218-0x21d); cases 5/6 use region-B compare (0x08088 on packed fields @0x221-0x226); case 7 compares 0x228/0x22c with borrow logic (overlap/order check).
evidence.result: analyze_function_complete(0x081b4): switch(state@0x251); comparators: 0x09570 (UTF16-ish string), 0x07f5c (packed coords @0x218-0x21d), 0x08088 (packed coords @0x221-0x226), case 7 uses signed compare on 0x228/0x22c.
